items.label: Coherent ECOC 2026 (09-21-2026)
items.signal_prefix: EVP Beck Mason said VCSEL arrays 'enable the lowest energy per bit for NPO applications'

set.signal: EVP Beck Mason said VCSEL arrays 'enable the lowest energy per bit for NPO applications' and very high channel counts in a dense package, giving 'the lowest cost and the best bandwidth density' of any option for integrated photonic links. He described two types for NPO: Type 1 conventional and Type 2 high density (the high-density 2D VCSEL he covered next as 'the other area', in production in the second half of calendar 2027). Type 1 is designed for ribbon fiber assemblies and is similar to what Coherent has sold for many years; Coherent has been 'supplying VCSEL arrays and PD arrays for more than 10 years' and he said it is 'the world's largest supplier of Datacom VCSELs today' (used in pluggable transceivers). In that Type 1 discussion he said the new arrays are 'high-density arrays. That means they are 2-dimensional', with more VCSEL channels, in flip-chip versions that mount directly on driver ICs; the photodiodes are likewise flip-chip for mounting on TIAs, and backside integrated lenses give more relaxed coupling, higher coupling efficiency and better link performance. 'These solutions will be production-ready in the first half of next calendar year.'
set.figure: supplying VCSEL arrays and PD arrays for more than 10 years; says it is the world's largest supplier of Datacom VCSELs; new 2D flip-chip arrays (Type 1 discussion) production-ready in the first half of next calendar year

items.reason: Old wording let the 1H-2027 production-ready date read as the Type 2 high-density part; Mason gives it before turning to 'the other area' (high-density 2D VCSEL, 2H 2027). Also attributes the 'world's largest' claim in the figure.
items.evidence: These solutions will be production-ready in the first half of next calendar year. The other area is our high-density 2D VCSELs
